This universal Tier 4 rating signifies that there is insufficient information to confidently assess any potential hazards for this chemical, warranting a precautionary approach.

Q3: Trimethylphenanthrene is not well characterized; it is classified as "Incompletely Defined" despite possessing a specific molecular formula (C17H16). With only 277 literature references and "Data Deficient" ratings across all hazard classes, there are significant gaps in the available information regarding its properties and potential hazards.
